name: WPTrigone Security – Secure your website and store
author: Olivier / WP Trigone

sections.description:
WPTrigone Security is a professional WordPress security plugin built for business websites, corporate sites, and WooCommerce stores that require a high level of protection without unnecessary complexity.

Key features

🛡️ Hide admin and login pages
🛡️ Enable CAPTCHA on the login page
🛡️ Disable PHP information disclosure
🛡️ Hide PHP version
🛡️ Disable XML-RPC
🛡️ Hide WordPress version
🛡️ Hide WooCommerce version

⚡️ Protection against brute force attacks
⚡️ WordPress login page hardening
⚡️ Hardening of sensitive WordPress settings
⚡️ Disabling unnecessary attack vectors
⚡️ WordPress admin area protection
⚡️ Security optimizations with no performance impact
⚡️ WooCommerce compatible
⚡️ No external services required
⚡️ GDPR compliant (no data collection)

Built for professionals

WPTrigone Security is ideal for:
✅ WordPress agencies
✅ Freelancers
✅ Managed WordPress hosting providers
✅ High-value SEO or e-commerce websites
✅ Clients looking for reliable and controlled security

External Services

This plugin integrates with Google reCAPTCHA to protect the login form against spam and automated abuse. Google reCAPTCHA is a security service provided by Google that helps distinguish between human users and automated bots. It is used to enhance login security.

When the login form is displayed, the plugin loads the Google reCAPTCHA JavaScript. When a user submits the login form, the reCAPTCHA response token, the site’s secret key, and the user’s IP address are sent to Google’s reCAPTCHA service.

This verification request is required to validate the reCAPTCHA challenge and determine whether the login attempt is legitimate.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the wptrigone-security folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin from the “Plugins” menu
  3. Access the settings from the dedicated menu
  4. Configure the options according to your needs
sections.faq:
Does this plugin replace a server firewall?

No. It complements server-level security (WAF, firewall, IDS) but does not replace it.

Is it compatible with WooCommerce?

Yes. Fully compatible, with no impact on checkout or customer accounts.

Does the plugin slow down the website?

No. All applied rules are lightweight and performance-friendly.

Is this an alternative to heavy security plugins?

Yes, for essential and professional needs. WPTrigone Security focuses on efficiency rather than feature overload.

Do you collect any data?

No. No data is sent to third-party services.

I lost my login URL!

Go to FTP in the /wp-content/plugins/ folder, rename the /wptrigone-security/ folder, return to the base URL /wp-admin/ and you will be able to log in again. Don’t forget to rename your folder correctly to /wptrigone-security/ to reactivate the plugin.

Is WPTrigone Security compatible with cache plugins?

Yes.

Is WPTrigone Security compatible with the multisite version of WordPress?

Yes.
